'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Brian Fred DS Death Star''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Fred]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
